## About this project

This page holds the replication code and the tables for a study of how pension
receipt (old age, widow and Annapurna pensions) is related to outpatient and
inpatient healthcare use among Indians aged 60-100, using LASI Wave 1.

## Read the tables

- [Analysis and tables](LASI_analysis.qmd): the full document with all tables.
  Use **Other Formats → PDF** in the right-hand side menu of that page to
  download it as a PDF.
- [Download the PDF directly](LASI_analysis.pdf)

## Tables in the analysis

1. [Summary statistics](LASI_analysis.qmd#summary-statistics)
2. [Main results: outpatient and inpatient use](LASI_analysis.qmd#main-results)
3. [Pension amount](LASI_analysis.qmd#pension-amount)
4. [Number of OPD visits: Tobit and negative binomial](LASI_analysis.qmd#tobit-and-negative-binomial-number-of-opd-visits)
5. [Heterogeneity (residence, caste, MPCE, education, age, gender, facility type)](LASI_analysis.qmd#heterogeneity-outpatient)
6. [Probit estimates with marginal effects](LASI_analysis.qmd#probit-outpatient)

Each table is also saved as a LaTeX file (folder `tables/`) that can be pasted
directly into Overleaf. They need `booktabs`, `adjustbox`, `float` and `amsmath`.

## Data

LASI microdata cannot be redistributed, so it is not part of this repository.
Request it from the LASI team (IIPS) and follow the steps in the README.
